intro.text: A minor member of the Set, based in Bilming.

items.text: In 348 PC Dip was at a Set safehouse in Bilming, awaiting a shipment that Elendel's constables had already seized; they planned to keep the rendezvous and raid it. When the trucks rolled in, Dip and Embrier went out to greet the Cycle in charge, and Dip grew steadily more suspicious of him.

While Wayne, disguised as Franis, drew Embrier aside, the Cycle, who was really VenDell in disguise, talked over the goods with Dip. Once Embrier ordered the trucks unloaded, he and Dip went off to fetch their superior, and while they were gone constables from Bilming, not Elendel, raided the warehouse.

appearance.text: Usually dressed for work, in suspenders, trousers and a buttoned shirt.
